Now we are unleashing the Saab 9-3 Griffin. A uniquely designed
and equipped model available in all four body styles. We are proud
to say that this is the best Saab 9-3 ever.
The new Scandinavian design touches make this edition of the Saab 9-3
look crisper and even more powerful. Take the driver’s seat and you’ll
find further proof of fresh attitude all around you. Start up, press on,
enjoy the road and discover what the latest engine technologies mean.
This car really does put some spice in your life.
